summary: iter_31 (Dashboard project context menu: Renommer/Supprimer + Chat AI tone rewrite). BACKEND 8/8 PASS: PUT /api/projects/{id} renames, DELETE /api/projects/{id} removes, 404 on nonexistent id; /api/chat/message replies to 'Bonjour'/'salut'/'hello'/'hi' with <=2 sentences, <=100 words and NO forbidden tech keywords (React/PWA/LocalStorage/composant/hooks/Ollama/GPT/OpenAI). Real tech question ('comment créer un site de recettes') still gets a substantive reply without provider name leaks. critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2251-2261 system_prompt — rules are explicit and in French: greetings answered in one sentence, ambiguous queries get a clarification question, provider names (Ollama/GPT/OpenAI) forbidden, no auto-promo bullets. Verified live on GPT-4o: 'Bonjour' → ~1-sentence greeting, no tech leakage; real tech question gets a concise non-promotional answer. System prompt is also properly localized via lang_label.

Dashboard.js L40-109 context-menu plumbing — ctxMenu/renameTarget/deleteTarget state is clean, useEffect closes menu on outside click + Escape, PUT and DELETE both include withCredentials. Inline rename input uses autoFocus, Enter submits, Escape cancels, onBlur also submits. Delete uses a real modal with cancel+confirm buttons. All 6 required data-testids present (project-ctx-menu, project-ctx-rename, project-ctx-delete, project-rename-{id}, project-delete-modal, project-delete-cancel, project-delete-confirm).

Dashboard.js L162-186 createNewProject — still uses window.prompt() for name+type. Functional but low-UX: keyboard users and mobile see native browser dialog. Consider switching to the existing Dialog/Input component for consistency. Non-blocker for iter_31 acceptance.
